import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile
import torch, numpy as np, gymnasium, stable_baselines3
from stable_baselines3 import PPO
from space_z.rl.gpt_training_rotation_continuous.train import ROOT,evaluate,write_json
from space_z.rl.gpt_training_rotation_continuous.report import compare
baseline=json.loads((ROOT/'baseline_development.json').read_text())[0]
previous=[episode for episode in baseline['episodes'] if episode['seed']>=43000]
sampled=json.loads((ROOT/'003_800k_sampled_development.json').read_text())[0]
comparison=compare(previous,sampled['episodes'])
write_json(ROOT/'003_800k_sampled_development_comparison.json',comparison)
print('Sampled 800k:',json.dumps(comparison['candidate']))
torch.set_num_threads(1)
model=PPO.load(ROOT/'experiments/003_body_stability/checkpoints/evaluated_000800000.zip',device='cpu')
rng=torch.get_rng_state().clone()
first=evaluate(model,[43001],2,deterministic=False)
assert torch.equal(rng,torch.get_rng_state())
second=evaluate(model,[43001],2,deterministic=False)
assert first==second
protected=json.loads((ROOT/'scope_before.json').read_text())
assert all(hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha for path,sha in protected.items())
with ZipFile(ROOT/'experiments/004_body_continuation/source_code.zip') as archive:
    assert 'process_slot.ps1' in archive.namelist()
    assert 'shared/src/space_z/rl/environment.py' in archive.namelist()
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(archive.read('shared/'+Path(path).as_posix())).hexdigest()==sha for path,sha in protected.items() if Path(path).suffix=='.py')
records=[json.loads(line) for line in (ROOT/'process_monitor.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines()]
post_guard=[record['owned_python_count'] for record in records if record['utc']>='2026-11-01T03:45:43']
assert max(post_guard)<=8
failure=json.loads((ROOT/'visual_003_500k_seed45506/frames.json').read_text())[-1]
reference=json.loads((ROOT/'003_500k_broader_development.json').read_text())[0]
expected=next(episode for episode in reference['episodes'] if episode['seed']==45506)
assert failure['score']==expected['score'] and failure['kills']==expected['kills'] and abs(failure['seconds']-expected['survival_seconds'])<1e-8
result=dict(stochastic_episode_repeated_identically=True,torch_training_rng_preserved=True,no_optimizer_updates=True,verification_environment_transitions=120,protected_sources_unchanged=len(protected),shared_source_archive_verified=True,maximum_observed_python_after_guard=max(post_guard),whole_study_maximum_observed_python=max(record['owned_python_count'] for record in records),failure_capture_matches_evaluation=True)
write_json(ROOT/'checks/replay_and_scope.json',result)
write_json(ROOT/'versions.json',dict(torch=torch.__version__,numpy=np.__version__,gymnasium=gymnasium.__version__,stable_baselines3=stable_baselines3.__version__))
print(result)

Adapt continuous rotation and fire with PPO in full game while preserving learned movement, growth and CNN weights

import os,torch,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from stable_baselines3 import PPO
from space_z.rl.gpt_training_rotation_continuous.train import ROOT,write_json
torch.set_num_threads(1)
parent=PPO.load(os.environ['ROTATION_PARENT_PATH'],device='cpu')
child=PPO.load(os.environ['ROTATION_CHILD_PATH'],device='cpu')
modules=[('features',parent.policy.features_extractor,child.policy.features_extractor),('movement_and_growth',parent.policy.action_net,child.policy.action_net),('body_actor',parent.policy.mlp_extractor.policy_net,child.policy.mlp_extractor.policy_net)]
unchanged={name:all(torch.equal(tensor,right.state_dict()[key]) for key,tensor in left.state_dict().items()) for name,left,right in modules}
assert all(unchanged.values()),unchanged
aim_changed=any(not torch.equal(tensor,child.policy.aim_net.state_dict()[key]) for key,tensor in parent.policy.aim_net.state_dict().items())
assert aim_changed
write_json(ROOT/'005_frozen_body_check.json',dict(unchanged=unchanged,aim_changed=aim_changed,parent_steps=parent.num_timesteps,child_steps=child.num_timesteps,parent_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(os.environ['ROTATION_PARENT_PATH']).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),child_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(os.environ['ROTATION_CHILD_PATH']).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),old_rotation_std=parent.policy.log_std.exp().item(),new_rotation_std=child.policy.log_std.exp().item()))
print('All body and CNN weights bit-identical; continuous aim/fire updated')

import numpy as np,torch
from gymnasium.spaces import Box,MultiDiscrete
from space_z.rl.gpt_training_rotation_continuous.policy import RotationContinuousPolicy
from space_z.rl.gpt_training_rotation_continuous.train import ROOT,write_json
torch.set_num_threads(1)
observations=Box(-1,1,(5139,),dtype=np.float32)
rejected=[]
for wrong_space in [Box(-1,1,(5,),dtype=np.float32),MultiDiscrete([9,9,2,6,5])]:
    try:
        RotationContinuousPolicy(observations,wrong_space,lambda progress:0.0001)
    except ValueError:
        rejected.append(type(wrong_space).__name__)
    else:
        raise AssertionError('Mismatched action schema was accepted')
write_json(ROOT/'checks/action_schema_validation.json',dict(rejected=rejected,no_optimizer_updates=True))
print('Wrong Box bounds and old MultiDiscrete rejected before training')
